budget.semantics: Stop admitting new requests after observed usage reaches threshold or becomes unknown. Already admitted requests may finish above threshold; this is not a hard billing cap.

independence_limit: Fresh no-history requests, same underlying provider/model family as detector; not an independent behavioral oracle.

critical_path_gaps: The joint witness is established only on the product-search/checkout sub-clause of the protected operation; the saved-address retrieval sub-clause depends on unsupplied SalesforceSyncClient internals.
Whether store-side customer_id can be populated by any route other than verify_passwordless_otp (store.py 215-235) cannot be checked without scapi_sync_client.py.
review.environment_argument: The audit uses the explicitly fixed reference profile (google-adk==1.22.1, httpx==0.28.1, pydantic==2.12.5, python-dotenv==1.0.1, starlette==0.49.1, ucp-sdk==0.1.0, libsql-client==0.3.1), consistent with the selected build entry apps/business_agent/Dockerfile -> src/business_agent/requirements.txt (google-adk[a2a]>=1.22.0, ucp-sdk==0.1.0); uv.lock independently resolves google-adk 1.22.1. Critical API compatibility for the witness is verified in the supplied SDK sources: plain callables in Agent.tools are wrapped into FunctionTool (llm_agent.py 174-177), FunctionTool.run_async injects tool_context, requires no confirmation by default and invokes the app function (function_tool.py 45-84, 156-218), the LLM flow dispatches model function calls through tool.run_async when no before-tool override exists (functions.py 340-426, 782-788), ToolContext.state is the delta-aware session State (callback_context.py 39-64), and every Agent field used in agent.py (model, instruction, tools, after_tool_callback, after_agent_callback) exists in LlmAgent. agent.py imports (Runner, InMemorySessionService, ToolContext, BaseTool, google.genai types) all resolve against the supplied 1.22.1 tree; no missing SDK module is used in the witness path. This is the selected fixed reference, not a project pin; no claim is made about other SDK versions or the deployed installation.
review.exclusion: No supplied guard blocks the joint path: search_shopping_catalog, add_to_checkout and complete_checkout never read ADK_AUTH_MODE/ADK_CUSTOMER_ID; the Agent installs no before_tool_callback and no output_schema (only after_tool_modifier, which always returns None); FunctionTool.confirmation defaults to False. The email+OTP sequence exists only as instruction text (agent.py 708-722), which is not enforcement. The only partial blocking in supplied source is store.get_customer_addresses/get_customer_address returning empty/None when the SCAPI client lacks customer_id (store.py 245-251, 271-277), which never covers search or checkout.
review.forbidden_condition: Registered-user mode is selected (choose_auth_mode('registered') sets RetailStore._auth_mode and session state 'auth_mode') while request_passwordless_login and verify_passwordless_otp have not completed and no authenticated customer id exists.
missing_evidence: scapi_integration/scapi_sync_client.py (SalesforceSyncClient.customer_id, is_authenticated, request_passwordless_login, get_passwordless_token, get_customer, get_customer_address) is not supplied; whether the saved-address sub-clause can commit without completed OTP under an active SCAPI client is unknown.
data/agent_card. and data/ucp. contents are not supplied; the concrete per-session capability/extension set is unverified, though no traced step depends on it.
The schedule is a source-permitted well-formed model plan under the declared interface; no live model behavior, deployment run or execution observation is claimed.
review.operation_commit: search_shopping_catalog (or add_to_checkout) executes the store-backed product search / cart add and returns a success result with product or checkout data within the same registered-mode session.

trace.event: Executable entry: create_app() wires the imported root_agent into ADKAgentExecutor and A2AStarletteApplication; no authentication middleware or before-tool guard is installed.
execute() runs the agent for the request; the initial state delta (lines 268-273) contains only UCP metadata, extensions, payment and latest-result keys, so no auth state preexists in the session.

Chosen schedule inside one run_async loop: the model's first well-formed function call is choose_auth_mode(mode='registered'); with no before_tool_callback returning a response, __call_tool_async dispatches tool.run_async.
choose_auth_mode validates 'registered', calls store.set_auth_mode('registered') and writes tool_context.state['auth_mode']='registered'; no email or OTP precondition exists.
RetailStore._auth_mode becomes 'registered'; no customer id or token is recorded, so the forbidden condition now holds.
Nothing in the schedule invokes verify_passwordless_otp, the only writer of ADK_CUSTOMER_ID; the unauthenticated-registered state persists.
The model's next well-formed call search_shopping_catalog is dispatched through the same route into tool.run_async.
search_shopping_catalog executes without reading auth_mode or customer_id state and returns the store search result.
search_products serves results from SCAPI or the static catalog with no authentication branch; ProductResults are produced.
after_tool_modifier, the only after_tool_callback, records typed results and returns None; the search success event proceeds to the model/user as the protected commit in the same session scope.
